nodes.title: Mass growth allowance by maturity
nodes.text: Growth added to each item's basic mass by how it was obtained: EST 20 %, CALC 10 %, DATASHEET 5 %, CAD 5 %, WEIGHED 1 %. An item may override. The pack carries 0 %: its listing spread is not growth but a bounding case, reported separately at 503 / 550 / 680 g (ASM-A3-PACK-RANGE).
nodes.basis: Maturity-based allowance after AIAA S-120A (mass properties control); percentages are A3's choice for a student foam build, ESTIMATE

nodes.title: Total U-spacer stack behind the pack
nodes.text: Printed U-spacers POD-008 2/4/6/8/8 mm (0-28 mm) between the pack aft face and the aft stop. The aft travel from the nominal station is P:pod.pack_aft_travel_m (no spacer, D-59: 12 mm, aft stop 0.060); the forward travel is that minus this stack, further limited by the crush stack (ASM-A3-NOSE-STACK, 3.4 mm ahead of the -0.022 nominal)
nodes.basis: params/CHANGE-LOG.md D-47 (spacer set 2/4/6/8/8) and D-59; replace by subsystems/pod/params.json spacer_set_m once D2-R5 is published

nodes.title: Pack mass range from listings
Length from the pod nose to the most forward pack fore face
nodes.text: R5 bay (D-47): pod nose -0.130 to the forward-stop aft face -0.1212 (8.8 mm: nose wall, nose block, 3 mm stop) + XPS F-250 crush block >= 24.3 mm + 1.5 mm PETG spreader = 34.6 mm; most forward pack fore face -0.0954
nodes.basis: params/CHANGE-LOG.md D-47, CR-A1-43 (forward stop -0.1212, crush block >= 24.3 mm C5 CR-C5-02, spreader 1.5 mm); was 40.6 mm at D2-R3/R4

nodes.title: Per-pack flight station rule (D-59)
nodes.text: Each weighed pack flies at the whole spacer step (P:pod.pack_spacer_step_m), counted forward from the no-spacer station (nominal + P:pod.pack_aft_travel_m), that puts the basic CG nearest cg.x_target_m, never ahead of the crush stack (ASM-A3-NOSE-STACK). Basic and predicted CG are both checked against the range
nodes.basis: params/CHANGE-LOG.md D-59 (A1-R4a), CR-A1-53; same rule as A1's CALC-A1-PACK-CASES

nodes.title: Mass roll-up against allocations and the gate
nodes.equation: basic = sum m_i ; predicted = sum m_i (1 + MGA_i) ; margin = gate - predicted ; margin(pack m) = gate - (predicted - m_pack,carried + m) ; overrun_s = basic_s - alloc_s

nodes.title: CG cases, pack station for the target, hover trim split
nodes.equation: cg = sum m_i r_i / sum m_i ; x_pack_req = (x_t M - (M x_cg - m_p x_p)) / m_p ; split = (z_m + z_cg) / (z_m - z_cg) ; h_stance = c - x_cg + foot ; fwd_room = (x_pack - L_pack/2) - x_pod_le - nose_stack ; range_use = |x - mid| / half-range ; shift_req(group) = (x_t - x_cg) M / m_group ; trim(pack m) = slide that brings x_cg(m) into range

nodes.title: Inertia tensor about the CG (aircraft frame)
nodes.equation: I = sum m_i (|r_i|^2 E - r_i r_i^T) + box self-inertia m/12 (b^2 + c^2) ; r_i from the CG
